name: topcoder-competitions-mcp
description: Topcoder (competitions): discover, get_competition, standings. Every tool maps to a documented endpo

tools.name: discover
tools.description: GET /v6/challenges: `search` matches name, description and tags; `status` open→Active, completed→Completed (upcoming is not a public status and is rejected); without `status` all public challenges are listed. Page size up to 100 (`perPage`). The response is a bare array; the total is only in the X-Total header, so `total` is null. Prizes (prizeSets, overview.totalPrizes, numbers), phases, numOfRegistrants and numOfSubmissions stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: GET /v6/challenges/{challengeId} (UUID). `description` is markdown; prizeSets, phases, terms and skills stay in `raw`.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: The challenge's `winners` array (placement, handle, userId) from GET /v6/challenges/{challengeId}; empty until the challenge completes. There is no public live leaderboard; `page`/`limit` do not apply.
